name: Pergamum

related_people.name: Antipas
related_people.role: Christ's “faithful witness,” put to death in this city

description: A city addressed in Revelation as the location of "Satan's throne," where a believer named Antipas was martyred; the church there is commended for faithfulness but rebuked for tolerating false teaching (Revelation 2:12-17).
family_friendly_summary: Pergamum was a city with one of the seven churches in the book of Revelation. Jesus calls it the place where "Satan's throne" is, and a faithful believer named Antipas was killed there for his faith. The church is praised for holding on, but warned about letting false teaching creep in.
